artifacts.notes: Reviewed snapshot for the exact Wikidata QIDs already present in institution_identifiers. It contains optional P2196 students count, P571 inception year, and HTTPS P856 official website values. Blank cells are intentional; no names or identity matches are imported. Wikidata is a community-maintained reference and these values must be checked against the institution's official source before an application decision.

Reviewed ROR-to-Wikidata crosswalk snapshot for exact ROR identifiers already present in the database. Only one-to-one ROR/QID matches are included. The companion importer adds the QID identifier; the enrichment importer then applies optional P2196 students count, P571 inception year, and HTTPS P856 official website values only when the profile field is still empty. Wikidata is a community-maintained reference and these values must be checked against the institution's official source before an application decision.

Reviewed facts companion to wikidata-ror-institution-facts-20260831.csv. Rows are the same one-to-one ROR/QID matches with the ROR column removed for the existing QID enrichment importer. Blank cells are intentional; no names or identity matches are inferred.
